items.title: James Chirillo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: Robert Fripp, those guys. I mean of course and Hendrix and all those, Jimmy Page, you name it.

ctx.x: Yeah, right. Robert Fripp, those guys. I mean of course and Hendrix and all those, Jimmy Page, you name it. So when I went down there, anything that I got exposed to was great. And they had a great classical department too, let alone the jazz department.
What did you get accepted as, and what got you in there? Your compositions?
